name: ecoste-recruit-tracker
description: Ecoste Recruit Tracker: recruitment workspace (openings, applications, interviews, offers, onboarding).

scripts.build: node scripts/gen-form-script.mjs && node scripts/gen-config.mjs && node scripts/build-single.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.test:e2e:all: npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:hooks && npm run test:e2e:flows && npm run test:e2e:auth
scripts.test:e2e:dist: npm run test:e2e -- dist && npm run test:e2e:hooks -- dist && npm run test:e2e:flows -- dist && npm run test:e2e:auth -- dist
